body.name: Selected-subdistribution cumulative envelopes
body.construction: For each \(m\in\mathcal M\), set \(L_m=H-m\), \(a_m=\sum_{b=m}^{H}p_b\), \(Q_s=\sum_{w=0}^{s}q_w\), and \(A_s=\sum_{b=H-s}^{H}p_b\). For every \(s\in\{0,\ldots,L_m\}\), set \(Z_{ms}^{-}=\min\{a_m,Q_s\}\) and \(Z_{ms}^{+}=Q_s+\max_{u\in\{s,\ldots,L_m\}}(A_u-Q_u)\).
